liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stealin'** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds Jerry's guitar licks especially unusual here; Reviewer says this version is only partly present, as if half of it is missing [5][9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Cream Puff War**: rare: 12 archived performances [14]
- **Stealin'**: rare: 14 archived performances [14]

## The recordings

- **gd66-10-07.sbd.unknown.14102.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 3 songs; 19 min; rated 2.5/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Well cut for its era, apart from one song where the vocals are poor; Reviewer describes the quality as excellent throughout [4][10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer argues Winterland was not a music venue in October 1966, so the date is doubtful [3]
- Reviewer owns a shirt giving Oct. 8, 1966, at the outdoor theatre on Mt. Tamipais [6]
- Wolfgang's Vault lists a Jefferson Airplane set that night at Winterland, between the Dead and the Butterfield Blues Band, opening a three-day run [8]
- Most sources label the show Fillmore; it may have been moved from Winterland [11]
- Deadbase XI indicates the show was moved to the Fillmore Auditorium; posters alone don't prove it happened [12]
- Same version as on the So Many Roads box set, which is listed as Fillmore Auditorium, July 1966 [3]
- Reviewer says it is the identical cut from the 7/16/66 Fillmore Auditorium show [3]
- Reviewer says it sounds good but they have heard better versions [9]
- Reviewer invites comparison with the 7/17/1966 Stealin' posted by Charlie Miller [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd66-10-07.sbd.unknown.14102.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Three of the songs were originally part of the SF Nights compilation, which is noted separately [1]
